changes: Explicit builder selection is immutable per reasoner instance and overrides interactive selection only during that instance's calls.
Lane availability and call dispatch use the same effective selection; operator pause, capability, credential and cooldown checks remain enforced.
Fresh issue, resumed PR and adopted PR builder construction reads the durable command pin. The workflow guard rejects a builder whose pin differs from the request before model calls.
Independent reviewer/adjudicator constructors retain their own selection. No global selection file or environment mutation is used.
Reading command pins is compatible with old workflow stores and does not create or migrate state.

routing_green.boundary: production routing with scripted provider adapters; no native model call

limits: Targeted CLI commands and queue consumption are not exposed yet.
Target-specific readiness for work-once without a worker is still required; the normal scheduler continues to use its deployment preflight.
Native paid acceptance of explicit pins, Discord sessions/updates, rollout and live soak remain unverified.
